tax.asOf: Rules as amended by the Finance Acts 2024–2025 (rates from 23 Jul 2024)

equity.label: Equity-oriented fund
equity.stcg: Held up to 12 months: 20% on gains
equity.ltcg: Held over 12 months: 12.5% on gains above ₹1.25 lakh per financial year (across all equity-oriented funds & listed shares)
equity.note: Securities Transaction Tax of 0.001% applies on redemption.

elss.label: Equity-oriented fund (ELSS)
elss.stcg: Not applicable — units are locked in for 3 years from each investment
elss.ltcg: After the 3-year lock-in: 12.5% on gains above ₹1.25 lakh per financial year
elss.note: Investments qualify for a deduction of up to ₹1.5 lakh a year under the old tax regime only.

debt.label: Specified (debt-oriented) fund
debt.stcg: Gains are added to your income and taxed at your slab rate, whatever the holding period
debt.ltcg: No long-term rate or indexation benefit for units bought on or after 1 Apr 2023
debt.note: Units bought before 1 Apr 2023 and held over 24 months: 12.5% without indexation.

other.label: Other fund (non-equity, non-specified)
other.stcg: Held up to 24 months: taxed at your slab rate
other.note: Applies to gold, silver and international fund-of-funds and hybrids that are neither equity-oriented nor debt-oriented.
